```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"This administration committed to hiring 100,000 Americans with disabilities within the federal government by 2015.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"This administration proposed new rules to create employment opportunities with federal contractors.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for expanding access to employment for people with disabilities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for removing barriers to work for people with disabilities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Affordable Care Act is opening access to health insurance to Americans with disabilities who were previously excluded because of pre-existing conditions.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Affordable Care Act is expanding access to Medicaid.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Affordable Care Act is helping Medicaid to support home- and community-based services to keep people in their communities.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The President issued an executive order repealing the restrictions on embryonic stem cell research.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The President signed into law the Christopher and Dana Reeves Paralysis Act, the first piece of comprehensive legislation aimed at improving the lives of Americans living with paralysis.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for ensuring that Americans with disabilities can exercise their right to vote and have access to the polls.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Opposition to all efforts to weaken the Americans with Disabilities Act.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Commitment to vigorously enforcing laws that prevent discrimination against people with disabilities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Opposition to harsh cuts in Medicaid that would inevitably lead to no or significantly less health care for millions of Americans with disabilities, workers with disabilities, and families raising children with autism, Down Syndrome, and other serious disabilities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
